note: Files that are never units (spec 07 §2.5), each excluded only when its bytes are what the name says: the lockfile (read by the dependency lens), raster images and fonts (laid out end to end as the format their extension names, and not readable as text; never sent to a model) and source maps. A name alone never excludes a file, because the pull request's author chooses it: code files (.ts, .tsx, .mts, .cts, .js, .jsx, .mjs, .cjs) are always units, generated or not, and SVG is reviewed as text. A file with a NUL in its first 8,000 bytes is binary by content; on tier S or N, a binary file that is not an image or a font blocks the run as a file no lens could review.
